name: 48th Annual Meeting of the Norwegian Association of Economists (Forskermøtet 2026)
conf_dates_note: Starts 9:15 on Monday 23 Nov and ends 14:15 on Tuesday 24 Nov (minor changes may occur)
deadline_note: Event page: 'Submission of papers/abstract: October 11'. The same page's form header says 'Registration closes Sunday, 11 October 23:59', while also listing 'Registration: November 1' as a separate deadline.
submission_requirements: Paper or abstract for contributed sessions in all areas of economics including finance; complete sessions also welcome; submitted via the event's registration form. PhD students particularly encouraged (prize for the best paper presented by a PhD student).
